speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: No me mires a mí. Yo solo pulso botones.
english: Don't look at me. I only push buttons.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Ahora no importa. Ahorremos lo que queda.
english: Doesn't matter now. Let's save what's left.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: {vessel}, combustible bajo. Os estamos calculando una ruta.
english: {vessel}, low fuel. We're working out a route for you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo tenemos. Esperad nuestros números antes de quemar.
english: We've got it. Wait for our numbers before you burn.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Recibido. Aquí esperamos, sin tocar nada.
english: Copy. We'll wait here, not touching anything.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Revisión de sistemas en marcha. Tómate tu tiempo.
english: Systems check underway. Take your time.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Copy. One light at a time.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, desde aquí se ve todo el centro espacial.
english: Control, I can see the whole space center from up here.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, qué vista desde lo alto del cohete.
english: Control, what a view from the top of the rocket.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Y todo el centro espacial te ve a ti.
english: And the whole space center can see you.

speaker: mission_control
english: Enjoy it. Soon you'll see a lot more.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Los ingenieros dicen que la nave está lista.
english: The engineers say the ship is ready.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Los mismos ingenieros de la última vez?
english: The same engineers as last time?

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, el asiento es más duro de lo que parecía.
english: Control, the seat is harder than it looked.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, este asiento no tiene cojín.
english: Control, this seat has no cushion.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo sentimos. El presupuesto era para el motor.
english: Sorry. The budget went to the engine.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo apuntamos para el próximo cohete.
english: We'll note it for the next rocket.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Viento suave en la plataforma. Buen día para volar.
english: Light wind on the pad. A good day to fly.

speaker: mission_control
english: The weather is on our side. Clear sky.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Recibido. Parece que el cielo espera.
english: Copy. Looks like the sky is waiting.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Perfecto. Ni una nube en el camino.
english: Perfect. Not one cloud in the way.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, ¿puedo comer algo antes de despegar?
english: Control, can I eat something before launch?

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, tengo hambre. ¿Hay tiempo para un bocadillo?
english: Control, I'm hungry. Is there time for a sandwich?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Después del despegue. Tu estómago lo agradecerá.
english: After launch. Your stomach will thank you.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Recibido. Sin novedad en la cabina.
english: Copy. Nothing new in the cockpit.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, la escalera ya se ve muy lejos.
english: Control, the ladder looks really far away now.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, la torre ya retiró el brazo.
english: Control, the tower already pulled its arm back.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Así debe ser. Ya no la necesitas.
english: That's how it should be. You don't need it anymore.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Correcto. Ya no hay vuelta atrás.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: El equipo de tierra se ha retirado. Solo quedas tú y el cohete.
english: The ground crew has pulled back. It's just you and the rocket.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Plataforma despejada. El cohete es todo tuyo.
english: Pad is clear. The rocket is all yours.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Copy. I hope it likes me.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Repaso la lista de comprobación una vez más.
english: Going over the checklist one more time.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Una última vuelta a la lista.
english: One last pass over the list.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Buena idea. Las listas salvan vidas.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: La torre informa todo en orden.
english: The tower reports everything in order.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Entendido. Por mi parte, todo listo.
english: Understood. All set on my end.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, aquí dentro alguien ya está nervioso.
english: Control, someone in here is already nervous.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, mi compañero no para de mover la pierna.
english: Control, my crewmate won't stop bouncing a leg.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Decidle que respire. Todo irá bien.
english: Tell them to breathe. It'll all be fine.

speaker: mission_control
english: Normal. Have them count to ten.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: We're all strapped in and set.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Toda la tripulación en su sitio.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recibido. Ya casi es la hora.

speaker: mission_control
english: We see it. Smooth and steady.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Recibido. Lo noto en los huesos.
english: Copy. I can feel it in my bones.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, el centro espacial ya se ve pequeño.
english: Control, the space center already looks small.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, el suelo se aleja muy rápido.
english: Control, the ground is falling away fast.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Y tú desde aquí pareces una chispa.
english: And from here you look like a spark.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Desde aquí eres un punto brillante.
english: From here you're a bright little dot.

speaker: mission_control
english: Heading is good. Keep it up.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vas justo por la línea. Perfecto.
english: You're right on the line. Perfect.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Pronto estarás por encima de todas.
english: Soon you'll be above all of them.

speaker: mission_control
english: Enjoy it. It's always sunny up there.

speaker: mission_control
english: The forces are right where they should be.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Recibido. Se nota en la cara.
english: Copy. I can feel it in my face.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, todo vibra pero va bien.
english: Control, everything is shaking but it's going well.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, mucho ruido pero todo en orden.
english: Control, lots of noise but everything's in order.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Las vibraciones son normales. Disfruta el viaje.
english: The vibrations are normal. Enjoy the ride.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te seguimos en el radar. Vuelo limpio.
english: We're tracking you on radar. Clean flight.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: En el radar todo se ve perfecto.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Gracias. Intento no hacer curvas raras.
english: Thanks. I'm trying not to make weird turns.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Glad to hear it. Following the line.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: What a noise! I love it.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¡Esto es mejor que en el simulador!
english: This is better than the simulator!

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Aquí también lo oímos. Las ventanas tiemblan.
english: We hear it here too. The windows are rattling.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo oímos desde la sala de control.
english: We can hear it from the control room.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, aquí nadie habla. Todos miran arriba.
english: Control, nobody is talking in here. Everyone is looking up.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, la tripulación está muy callada.
english: Control, the crew is very quiet.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Disfrutadlo. Solo se vive una vez.
english: Enjoy it. You only get to do it once.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Buen ascenso, equipo. Seguid el plan.
english: Good climb, team. Stick to the plan.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Todo según el plan. Seguid así.
english: All according to plan. Keep it up.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, this is shaking way too much!

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, the whole rocket is shaking!

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo vemos. Aguanta, pronto se calma.
english: We see it. Hang on, it settles soon.

speaker: mission_control
english: Normal in this phase. Hold on.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Presión dinámica alta. Cuidado con el acelerador.
english: High dynamic pressure. Careful with the throttle.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Mucha presión del aire. Baja un poco el empuje.
english: Lots of air pressure. Ease off the thrust a little.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: The ship is tilting on its own!

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Corrige suave. No luches contra ella.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Son las fuerzas G. Respira con calma.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te desvías un poco del rumbo.
english: You're drifting off course a bit.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Atención, te sales de la línea.
english: Heads up, you're leaving the line.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: On it! Give me a second!

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¡Algo ha hecho un ruido muy feo!
english: Something just made a really ugly noise!

speaker: mission_control
english: We don't see anything odd. Carry on.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Mucha carga en la estructura. Ojo.
english: Heavy load on the structure. Careful.

speaker: mission_control
english: Turn on SAS and hang on.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Is it normal for it to shake this much?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Más o menos. Mantén el rumbo.
english: More or less. Hold your heading.

speaker: mission_control
english: Heads up, the ship is oscillating.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: I can feel it in my stomach!

speaker: kerbal_a
english: I can't even lift my arm!

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No hace falta. Deja que el cohete trabaje.
english: No need. Let the rocket do the work.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tranquilidad. El piloto automático lo tiene.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: La presión sube. Ya casi pasas lo peor.
english: Pressure rising. You're almost past the worst.

speaker: mission_control
english: Almost at max Q. Hang on.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¡El panel parece un árbol de luces!
english: The panel looks like a light show!

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ignora las amarillas. Avisa si salen rojas.
english: Ignore the yellow ones. Tell us if red ones come on.

speaker: mission_control
english: We see them. None of them are serious.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, dime que esto va bien.
english: Control, tell me this is going well.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, is everything fine? Be honest.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Va bien. Un poco movido, pero bien.
english: It's going well. A bit bumpy, but well.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Va bien. Confía en el cohete.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Cuidado con los ángulos. Sin giros bruscos.
english: Watch the angles. No sharp turns.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¡No hago giros bruscos! ¡Los hace el cohete!
english: I'm not making sharp turns! The rocket is!

speaker: kerbal_a
english: It's not me, it's the rocket!

speaker: kerbal_a
english: The rocket does whatever it wants!

speaker: kerbal_a
english: This thing won't listen to me!

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Estructura al límite. Reduce un poco el empuje.
english: Structure at its limit. Reduce thrust a little.

speaker: mission_control
english: Too much force. Pull the throttle back.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: The bolts sound like an orchestra!

speaker: mission_control
english: As long as they play together, it's fine.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Es la música del despegue. Aguanta.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, la punta se mueve mucho.
english: Control, the nose is moving a lot.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, la nariz no se queda quieta.
english: Control, the nose won't stay still.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo vemos. Mantén la nariz en el rumbo.
english: We see it. Keep the nose on heading.

speaker: mission_control
english: Hold it steady. Don't fight it.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Mucha velocidad para esta altura. Calma.
english: Lots of speed for this altitude. Stay calm.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vas muy rápido aquí abajo. Con cuidado.
english: You're going very fast down low. Careful.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Calm! Easy to say from down there!

speaker: kerbal_a
english: I'm trying! This is a rocket!

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¡Aquí dentro todos se agarran a algo!
english: Everyone in here is grabbing onto something!

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¡La tripulación se agarra a los asientos!
english: The crew is gripping their seats!

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perfecto. Agarrados hasta que se calme.
english: Perfect. Hold on until it settles.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Agarraos, va a moverse un poco.
english: Hold on, it's going to get bumpy.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Atención todos, viene un tramo movido.
english: Heads up, everyone, bumpy stretch ahead.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: A bit?! We're being shaken around!

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Que grite. Mientras el cohete suba, todo bien.
english: Let them. As long as the rocket climbs, all is well.

speaker: mission_control
english: We see it. Hang on, almost there.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Aguantad un poco más. Pronto se calma.
english: Hang on a bit longer. It calms down soon.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¡Todos aquí piensan que esto se rompe!
english: Everyone in here thinks this thing is breaking!

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Nobody in here trusts the rocket!

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No se rompe. Mantened la calma.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Confiad en el cohete. Está bien construido.
english: Trust the rocket. It's well built.
